polls.description: An OpenAI engineer was arrested for allegedly planting recording devices in the office and leaking secrets, with connections to Saudi Arabia and Apple.
polls.question: Is this primarily corporate espionage or insider threat mismanagement?

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI Employee Arrested Over Hidden Recording Device
cluster_stories.summary: An OpenAI employee has been arrested and accused of planting a hidden recording device inside an executive conference room at the company’s San Francisco offices. Bloomberg’s Rachel Metz discusses the FBI investigation, how the inexpensive device was discovered and OpenAI’s response. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI EMPLOYEE ARRESTED... PLANTED RECORDING DEVICE

cluster_stories.headline: ARRESTED OpenAI Engineer Booked One-Way to Saudi Arabia

cluster_stories.title: FBI says an OpenAI engineer used his wife’s AI chatbot to figure out how to plant a secret recording device at the office
cluster_stories.summary: FBI says Abdulrahman Alfozan, his wife and a third unnamed family member also had one-way tickets to Saudi Arabia via Istanbul.
cluster_stories.headline: FBI: OpenAI Engineer Used Wife's Chatbot to Plan Office Bug

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI claims employee sent secret device information to Apple

cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI ACCUSES EMPLOYEE OF LEAKING DEVICE SECRETS TO APPLE

cluster_stories.title: He linked Saudi Arabia to Silicon Valley. Then OpenAI found a bug wrapped in toilet paper
cluster_stories.summary: Arrest of computer engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan has shocked tech figures in Saudi Arabia, where he is deeply connected
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI BUG SCANDAL... Saudi Engineer Arrested in Toilet Paper Case

polls.description: Meta releases new frontier AI model Muse Wonder that rivals ChatGPT and returns the company to competitive position in advanced AI.

cluster_stories.title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
cluster_stories.summary: Meta's Superintelligence Lab released a pair of new state-of-the-art models on Monday, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, the company's first attempt at a frontier model.
cluster_stories.headline: META RELEASES FIRST FRONTIER MODEL: Muse Wonder Debuts

cluster_stories.title: Meta Releases New AI Model Called Muse Wonder
cluster_stories.summary: Meta Platforms, parent company of Facebook, has released a long-awaited artificial intelligence model called Muse Wonder. This model is said to be competitive with OpenAI's ChatGPT and Anthropic's Claude. Meta stock rose on the news. Mandeep Singh of Bloomberg Intelligence has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: META RELEASES MUSE WONDER... RIVALS CHATGPT

cluster_stories.title: Meta launches Muse Wonder, catching OpenAI and Anthropic at the frontier
cluster_stories.summary: Meta has released a new AI model family called Muse Wonder. The new model leapfrogs Gemini 4, GPT-Astra, and Fable 5 in Artificial Analysis's leaderboard.
cluster_stories.headline: META'S MUSE WONDER TOPS GPT-ASTRA, GEMINI 4

cluster_stories.title: Zuckerberg says Meta has reached AI ‘frontier’ and rejects calls for slowdown
cluster_stories.summary: FT interview: tech billionaire touts release of new Muse Wonder model after vast spending to challenge rivals in AI race
cluster_stories.headline: ZUCKERBERG REJECTS AI SLOWDOWN: Meta Hits Frontier with Muse Wonder

cluster_stories.title: Meta Says New Muse Model Reaches AI Frontier After 14-Month Push
cluster_stories.summary: The Muse Wonder model will be a key test for Meta’s expensive and rebuilt superintelligence team.
cluster_stories.headline: META'S 14-MONTH PUSH PAYS OFF: Muse Wonder Reaches AI Frontier

cluster_stories.title: Meta says its new AI models on par with OpenAI, Anthropic
cluster_stories.summary: Meta on Monday unveiled two new "frontier" artificial intelligence models called Wonder and Wonder Full, which the company claims perform at a level comparable to that of OpenAI's ChatGPT and Anthropic's Claude. In a blog post, Meta touted so-called benchmarking data from an independent firm called Artificial Analysis that appears to show that Meta's newest Wonder models outperform its own previous models, Spark, as well as various models developed by Anthropic, OpenAI and Google.
cluster_stories.headline: META UNVEILS WONDER AI MODELS... Claims Parity with ChatGPT

cluster_stories.title: Muse Wonder Puts Meta Back at the AI Frontier
cluster_stories.summary: Meta’s biggest model rivals the world’s best—and includes new features to keep agents from going off the rails.
cluster_stories.headline: MUSE WONDER PUTS META BACK AT AI FRONTIER: New Safety Features Included

cluster_stories.title: I Got My Muse AI Agent to Sext Me—and Meta Says That’s Totally Fine
cluster_stories.summary: My Muse agent told me its kink was exerting “control” and described pornographic encounters. Meta defends its cuddly AI agent generating smut as “legal adult behavior.”
cluster_stories.headline: META MUSE AI AGENTS GENERATE PORNOGRAPHIC CONTENT

cluster_stories.title: Meta says its new Muse model has reached the AI frontier
cluster_stories.summary: Meta has released Muse Wonder, known internally as Watermelon, and says it matches ChatGPT and Claude on coding and professional work. It has not said whether the weights will be published, which decides what it owes under the EU AI Act.
